name: Email OTP Login
description: Passwordless login for existing Drupal users via a one-time code emailed to their registered address. A user enters their email at /otp-email, receives a 6-digit code, and enters it at /validate-otp/{email} to be logged in.
project_description: This module enables registered users to log in to the Drupal site using a one-time password (OTP) sent to their registered email address, instead of entering their account password. It is only available for accounts that already exist on the site and does not support anonymous registration. The module adds two routes: a form at /otp-email to request a code and a form at /validate-otp/{email} to enter it. A site builder typically exposes the /otp-email path through a menu link. The OTP email subject and body are built in hook_mail() and can be altered by a mail-alteration module or a custom theme.
